CustomField.description: FORMAT/INTENT axis (distinct from the Source_Type__c trust axis). Controls how Drafting uses the body: template/procedure = reproduce faithfully, fill placeholders, do not truncate; reference/explainer = synthesize, truncatable. Populated by an ingestion body heuristic (merge tokens, ac: macros, tables, step-lists) with a label override; default explainer so the safe failure mode is "synthesize" rather than "reproduce prose as a verbatim template".
CustomField.label: Solution Type
